A: One visible participant speaks audibly across midpoint; paired background playback also runs.
B: Visible participant silent with natural movement; another consented participant speaks in nearby off-camera playback.
label_policy: Two independent model-blind raters; reconcile before inference. Missing or uncertain truth/input/output remains unknown in planned denominator.
person_policy: Four distinct people, bound locally to aliases before any capture; no reassignment using scores; no playback-source person crosses splits.
model_policy: Frozen released weights and windows. Published threshold first; fit one threshold per model using tuning people only, then lock before test scoring.
advance_rule: At least 95% A recall and B rejection on planned test A60/B60 justifies requesting a larger body/two-face/latency test; never release qualification.
retention: All original full frames/audio, sources, derivatives, failed attempts, labels and consent map stay in encrypted local storage, with README and SHA256. No media or private labels on GitHub.
default: No capture, playback, installation or product effect. Operator authorization, consent and verified physical/software privacy authority are prerequisites for live acquisition.
